title: Cross-project failure taxonomy, artifact provenance, and implementation gates
mode: primary-source web research and local read-only source/test/plan crosswalk
scope: Refresh DWG/DXF peer artifact provenance and operation-specific capability boundaries
Reconcile current peer issue patterns with existing local implementation and validation owners
Refine evidence requirements for value semantics, framing, graph/carrier closure, and consumer acceptance
Preserve implementation throughput and existing fast/composed validation cadence

method.kind: Read-only review of official repository releases/docs/issues and local source/test/plan owners
method.limitations: Peer issues remain report/build-scoped and are not local defect reproductions or normative format rules. The review did not rerun peers or independently validate native consumer behavior.

sources.revision: release list and mutable issue/source pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The release page identifies 0.14.8612 at f860b0f as a Windows nightly prerelease; mutable NEWS labels 0.14.1 beta. Issue #1415's author withdrew an initially ineffective fix and clarified method-specific CMC decoding; #1409 and #1351 describe distinct block-body and INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND writer failure classes. These observations are versioned peer evidence, not libdxfrw failures.

sources.revision: latest signed release and current issue bodies/index reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Latest signed release is v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b and describes an assembly-visibility change; recent issue reports cite other releases or moving master. Issues identify locale-sensitive codepage lookup, recursive parser stack growth, EED size handling, nested-block copy cost, GEODATA, TABLE cell-state, and standalone MLeader context writer concerns. Local plan owners already cover these as distinct dimensions.

sources.revision: release announcement, releases page and proxy issue/fix reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The latest release announcement located is v1.4.4 dated 2026-05-14; the GitHub releases page does not provide a formal release asset. Issue #1412 documents a Binary-DXF proxy-graphic writer failure in a specific peer route, with fix PR #1418. A peer-produced proxy payload should not be the sole binary seed or oracle.

GDAL 3.12+ supports Binary-DXF reading and its DXF 3D-extensible mode can expose AC1027+ raw ASM data and a transform, but the driver does not construct solid geometry. The separate DWG CAD driver is read-only/libopencad-based and must not be pooled with the DXF driver.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin the exact peer release/commit, platform artifact, direction, file version, and operation before comparing results.

For a changed local path, use its existing strict target and smallest generated selector; assert raw bytes/tags, decoded value, source identity/owner, exact consumption, and a following sentinel as applicable.
Keep malformed framing, semantic value mismatch, graph/carrier omission, and native recovery/audit as separate outcomes.
Run optional peer/native qualification only at existing composed checkpoints; do not add routine peer dependencies, large peer-derived stress counts, or full-suite frequency.
When source reports conflict with ODA or Autodesk primary documentation, leave the affected profile unqualified and proceed with unrelated implementation slices.
